units.source_text: 秀男无法相信她的话，他说不出话来，现出了一副沮丧的脸。

en.t: Hideo could not believe what she had said; he was speechless, his face clouded with dejection.

units.source_text: 因为他是为千重子设计图案才付出这么大的心血，难道千重子就此打算完全拒绝他吗？

en.t: He had poured so much of his heart into designing the patterns for Chieko; did she really mean to reject him completely now?
